metadata.description: Agent skills for configuring Keycloak/Phase Two extension behaviors, for vanilla Keycloak and Phase Two hosted Keycloak.

plugins.name: phasetwo
plugins.description: Keycloak administration and application-security skills for Phase Two and self-hosted Keycloak. `keycloak` routes realm-administration work — passwordless login, enterprise SSO and identity-provider federation, organization login restriction, credential enrollment, cluster provisioning. `securing-apps` wires Keycloak login and bearer-token validation into your own React, Angular, Vue, Next.js, mobile or backend app.
